title: Should India bring back compulsory military service?
summary: A common GTO discussion topic. Points on both sides and a balanced way to close.
body: India has never had compulsory military service; all three services have always been all-volunteer. Some countries, such as Israel, South Korea and Singapore, have conscription. The topic often comes up alongside the Agnipath scheme.
Instead of full conscription, India could expand NCC, offer short voluntary service schemes and build a stronger reserve, getting many of the benefits without the cost.
pros: Builds discipline, fitness and national integration among youth
Creates a large trained reserve for emergencies
Brings people of different regions and classes together
Reduces the gap between civilians and the forces
cons: India has more volunteers than vacancies; there is no shortage
Huge cost to train, house and equip millions every year
Unwilling soldiers can lower the quality of a professional force
Takes youth away from education and work at a key age
interview: What is the difference between conscription and the Agnipath scheme?
